items.title: Hashtag Kalakar Fully Funded Artists Residency
items.location: Multiple global cities (artist choice: NYC, Paris, Berlin, Florence, Tokyo, Mumbai, Jaipur and others)
items.funding:
Fund: application fee only
Application fee: USD $50
Programme fee: none (covered if selected)
Travel: covered (round-trip economy if selected)
Stay: covered (accommodation for 30 days if selected)
Living: you pay (food and personal expenses not included)
You pay in total: USD $50 (plus living costs if selected)
items.eligibility: Visual artists (painting, drawing, sculpture, mixed media, digital, etc.), any nationality, age 18+. Degree: not required. Who can apply: emerging to established visual artists worldwide. IELTS: not required. NET: not required. Language: English. Age: 18+.
items.visaSponsor: Invitation letter provided; visa approval depends on embassy
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Hashtag Kalakar page. Participation fee USD 50 for jury; if selected among top 25, flights, accommodation and programme covered. Food/personal not covered.

items.title: .ART Award 2026
items.location: Online submission; winners announced at Art Basel Miami
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: not stated (residency prizes may include)
Stay: not stated (residency prizes may include)
Living: not stated
You pay in total: not stated (requires a .ART domain; registration cost separate if new)
items.eligibility: Individual artists and collectives aged 18+, any medium or art form, worldwide. Degree: not required. Who can apply: open to all artists 18+. IELTS: not required. NET: not required. Language: English for submission. Age: 18+.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official award.art. Free to submit (requires .ART domain linked to bio, work, and story). Prizes include USD 15,000 cash, residencies in France and Spain, and more. Deadline 1 November 2026 12:00 UTC.

items.title: IIT Bhilai Artist in Residency Programme
items.org: IIT Bhilai, Centre for Studies on Culture, Language and Traditions (CCLT)
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: not stated
Stay: covered (accommodation provided)
Living: covered (monthly honorarium/stipend; exact amount not stated on page)
You pay in total: not stated
items.eligibility: Artists and arts practitioners based in Chhattisgarh working on performing arts and handicrafts / traditional art forms of the state. Degree: not required (focus on practice). Who can apply: Chhattisgarh-based practitioners of state art forms. IELTS: not required. NET: not required. Language: not stated. Age: not stated.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official IIT Bhilai CCLT page. 3-month residency for Chhattisgarh artists in performing arts and handicrafts; monthly honorarium, accommodation and studio provided. Strong fit only if practice aligns with traditional/folk forms of the state.
